# tensquads design system

> Design foundations and React components for tensquads and بنّاء.

## Start here

- [Design system](markdown/home.md): Install the package and find foundations and components.
- [نظام تصميم بنّاء](markdown/home-ar.md): الصفحة الرئيسية بالعربية.
- [Colour tokens](markdown/foundation-colour.md): Semantic and primitive values for light and dark.
- [Component index](markdown/components.md): React components by category.
- [Get started](https://tensquads-ui-preview.mohanadgh.workers.dev/get-started): Set up React and OpenUI.
- [Library llms.txt](https://github.com/moeghashim/tensquads-ui/blob/main/llms.txt): Published library documentation.
